_README: Map the villa photos to each section. Put source filenames from the /Images folder WITHOUT extension (e.g. "A-12") into each `sources` array, in display order. Then run `npm run process-images` to generate optimised WebP files in /public/images. The galleries read from this same file, so this is the only place you set the photo lineup.
